source.note: Club announcement of the Winline deal: the bookmaker's logo goes on the game and training kit. Russian; 'the bookmaker's logo — on the game and training kit of the black-and-whites'. The club's own 2026-27 match photos (gallery 26/27 Traktor vs SKA, 25 Sep 2026) show the Winline oval above the back number. The page shows no dateline; it states the deal took effect on 15 July and ran to the end of 2024/25, and the same-day Metaratings piece on the deal is dated 15.07.2022.

summary: 2026-27 home kit (black, '#onlyblackandwhite'). Winline above the back number and on the sleeve; RMK on the shoulder yoke; TMK patch on the lower front; Bovid on the sleeve; T-Bank (top of back) and MIR (chest) as KHL league-partner patches; KONAR on helmets; Ikar, Spetstekhproekt and OTV as club partners without a documented jersey placement. Club sponsor list from the club site footer; jersey placements from the club's own 2026-27 match photos. SOGAZ on the goalie mask is a KHL league partner (see PR). sponsorsComplete is false: shorts and socks were not checked, and any placement not visible in the club's published photos remains unverified.
